'''October 2001 Garden Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Mile High Comics, Garden Grove, CA on 6 October 2001. [[John Patchell]] won it. It is known from Darryll Silva's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3050">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-11-this-is-getting-old-gg-ca-10-6-01d3050/ this-is-getting-old-gg-ca-10-6-01], DeckTech (Darryll "217" Silva, 11 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-11-this-is-getting-old-gg-ca-10-6-01d3050/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Mile High Comics, Garden Grove, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[John Patchell]]
